title: Thai Style Fish Fry
description: A spicy and flavorful Thai-inspired dish made with fish, a blend of aromatic spices, and a hint of sweetness.
instructions: Marinate the fish fillets in a mixture of unique rice vinegar, savory soy sauce, and Thai red curry paste for 10 minutes.
Heat the Portuguese olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced green onions and stir-fry bell peppers to the pan and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the marinated fish fillets to the pan and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side.
Add the fry onions to the pan and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the Thai style fish fry hot and garnish with additional green onions and stir-fry bell peppers if desired.
